subject: Oceanography
title: The Antarctic Treaty
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Antarctic Treaty.

hook.text: Antarctica is the only continent with no government—it's managed by an international treaty signed in 1959.

buildup.text: The Antarctic Treaty dedicates the continent to peace and science—banning military activity and mining.

discovery.text: 54 nations now participate—operating over 70 research stations across the continent.

twist.text: Seven countries claim territory, but the treaty freezes all claims—no one owns Antarctica, officially.

climax.text: As resources become scarce and ice retreats, pressure on the treaty's mining ban grows.

punchline.text: One treaty keeps an entire continent free for science—for now.

quiz.question: What does the Antarctic Treaty ban?
